named_premises: The sign operator is fixed in a 2D basis as sigma = diag(+1, -1), so both sign eigenspaces are non-empty.
The sign operator has spectrum {-1, +1} and satisfies sigma^2 = I and sigma^dagger = sigma.
The encoding faithfully represents the intended domain; any formal-to-world identification needs an independently warranted bridge.
receipt: Existence and uniqueness up to scalar of a non-unitary one-direction Grace operator anticommuting with the sign operator on a two-dimensional sign space.
